findings.text: blocking: the only gate log at the reviewed head is header-only — five lines, no pytest summary, no EXIT= line — while the manifest's after_suite names revision 3173f788b and its commits line does not mention b9efcc6b8 at all, so the reviewed head's own source change (the widened guard at reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:425) has never been through a completed gate; re-running the population with this log finished, and recording b9efcc6b8 in commits, is the repair.

blocking: adding the 'seat moved' pane word leaves three pre-existing ticker tests red at head and green at base — tests/test_the_pane_speaks_seven_words.py::test_every_internal_state_has_exactly_one_pane_word, tests/test_ticker_row_is_one_transition.py::test_every_pane_word_is_a_hued_table_key and tests/test_the_stream_carries_only_actionable_lines.py:142::test_the_rule_names_the_words_the_stream_carries (the third compares a literal frozenset against ticker.CARRIED_PANE_WORDS at that line) — so the done_when's 'add no failures against the base' is unmet and promoting this head alone leaves main red; the node names all three with one-line patches under outside_scope, and those patches must land with it in the same wave.

non-blocking: 'except Exception: return' makes a lost announcement completely silent — no line to the producer's own log (watch_log_path) and no counter — so the one case this guard exists for, a stream the release could not write, is the case a later reader has no way to find; the release already printed its verdict to stdout at :460, so writing one line there or to the producer log costs nothing and preserves the 'never blocks the release' intent.
